19500-can-you-forgive-her.title: Can You Forgive Her?

19500-can-you-forgive-her.description: A book by Anthony Trollope. Containing a Love Letter. Containing an Answer to the Love Letter. Vavasor Speaks to His Daughter. John Grey Goes a Second Time to London. Greenow's Little Dinner in the Close. The Election for the Chelsea Districts. George Vavasor Takes His Seat. Cheesacre's Disappointment. Preparations for Lady Monk's Party. How Lady Glencora Went to Lady Monk's Party.

arxiv-2203-02699.title: A Study of Preference and Comfort for Users Immersed in a Telepresence Robot Thanks: *This work was supported by a European Research Council Advanced Grant (ERC AdG, ILLUSIVE: Foundations of Perception Engineering, 101020977), Academy of Finland (projects PERCEPT 322637, CHiMP 342556), and Business
arxiv-2203-02699.creator: Adhi Widagdo, Markku Suomalainen, Basak Sakcak, Katherine J. Mimnaugh
arxiv-2203-02699.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Adhi Widagdo, Markku Suomalainen, Basak Sakcak, Katherine J. Mimnaugh. In this paper, we show that unwinding the rotations of a user immersed in a telepresence robot is preferred and may increase the feeling of presence or “being there”. By immersive telepresence, we mean a scenario where a user wearing a head-mounted display embodies a mobile robot equipped with a 360° camera in another location, such that the user can move the robot and communicate with people around it.

arxiv-2203-09636.title: A Density Evolution framework for Preferential Recovery of Covariance and Causal Graphs from Compressed Measurements
arxiv-2203-09636.creator: Muralikrishnna G. Sethuraman, Hang Zhang, Faramarz Fekri
arxiv-2203-09636.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a general framework for designing sensing matrix 𝑨 ∈ ℝ d × p \bm{A}\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times p} , for estimation of sparse covariance matrix from compressed measurements of the form 𝒚 = 𝑨 ​ 𝒙 + 𝒏 \bm{y}=\bm{A}\bm{x}+\bm{n} , where 𝒚 , 𝒏 ∈ ℝ d \bm{y},\bm{n}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} , and 𝒙 ∈ ℝ p \bm{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{p} .

arxiv-2209-01685.title: ASTra: A Novel Algorithm-Level Approach to Imbalanced Classification
arxiv-2209-01685.creator: David Twomey, Denise Gorse
arxiv-2209-01685.description: Abstract We propose a novel output layer activation function, which we name ASTra (Asymmetric Sigmoid Transfer function), which makes the classification of minority examples, in scenarios of high imbalance, more tractable. We combine this with a loss function that helps to effectively target minority misclassification.

arxiv-2305-10251.title: Model of Cosmic Ray Propagation in the Milky Way at the Knee
arxiv-2305-10251.creator: G. Giacinti 1,2 and D. Semikoz 3
arxiv-2305-10251.description: Abstract We present a new model of anisotropic cosmic ray propagation in the Milky Way, where cosmic rays are injected at discrete transient sources in the disc and propagated in the Galactic magnetic field. In the framework of our model, we show that the cosmic ray spectrum is time-dependent and space-dependent around the energy of the knee.

arxiv-2309-12961.title: On schemes evinced by generalized additive decompositions and their regularity
arxiv-2309-12961.creator: Alessandra Bernardi, Alessandro Oneto, Daniele Taufer*
arxiv-2309-12961.description: Abstract . We define and explicitly construct schemes evinced by generalized additive decompositions (GADs) of a given d d -homogeneous polynomial F F . We employ GADs to investigate the regularity of 0 0 -dimensional schemes apolar to F F , focusing on those satisfying some minimality conditions.

arxiv-2404-02768.title: Locking-free hybrid high-order method for linear elasticity Thanks: The authors thank Lukas Gehring (Universität Jena) for his valuable comments that lead to the completion of the proof of Lemma 3.6 . The second author received funding from the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation p
arxiv-2404-02768.creator: Carsten Carstensen and Ngoc Tien Tran
arxiv-2404-02768.description: Abstract . The hybrid-high order (HHO) scheme has many successful applications including linear elasticity as the first step towards computational solid mechanics. The striking advantage is the simplicity among other higher-order nonconforming schemes and its geometric flexibility as a polytopal method on the expanse of a parameter-free refined stabilization.

arxiv-2504-02512.title: Towards Generalizing Temporal Action Segmentation to Unseen Views
arxiv-2504-02512.creator: Emad Bahrami, Olga Zatsarynna, Gianpiero Francesca, Juergen Gall
arxiv-2504-02512.description: Abstract While there has been substantial progress in temporal action segmentation, the challenge to generalize to unseen views remains unaddressed. Hence, we define a protocol for unseen view action segmentation where camera views for evaluating the model are unavailable during training. This includes changing from top-frontal views to a side view or even more challenging from exocentric to egocentric views.

arxiv-2505-15197.title: Intentional Gesture: Deliver Your Intentions with Gestures for Speech
arxiv-2505-15197.creator: Pinxin Liu, Haiyang Liu, Luchuan Song, Chenliang Xu
arxiv-2505-15197.description: Abstract When humans speak, gestures help convey communicative intentions, such as adding emphasis or describing concepts. However, current co-speech gesture generation methods rely solely on superficial linguistic cues ( e.g. speech audio or text transcripts), neglecting to understand and leverage the communicative intention that underpins human gestures.

arxiv-2511-23199.title: Vision Bridge Transformer at Scale
arxiv-2511-23199.creator: Zhenxiong Tan, Zeqing Wang, Xingyi Yang, Songhua Liu, Xinchao Wang
arxiv-2511-23199.description: Abstract We introduce Vision Bridge Transformer (ViBT) , a large-scale instantiation of Brownian Bridge Models designed for conditional generation. Unlike traditional diffusion models that transform noise into data, Bridge Models directly model the trajectory between inputs and outputs, creating an efficient data-to-data translation paradigm. By scaling these models to 20B and 1.

arxiv-2602-23941.title: EDDA-Coordinata: An Annotated Dataset of Historical Geographic Coordinates
arxiv-2602-23941.description: Abstract This paper introduces a dataset of enriched geographic coordinates retrieved from Diderot and d’Alembert’s eighteenth-century Encyclopédie . Automatically recovering geographic coordinates from historical texts is a complex task, as they are expressed in a variety of ways and with varying levels of precision.

plos-pone-0002074.title: Utilization of a Deoxynucleoside Diphosphate Substrate by HIV Reverse Transcriptase
plos-pone-0002074.creator: Scott J. Garforth, Michael A. Parniak, Vinayaka R. Prasad
plos-pone-0002074.description: PLOS ONE research article. Deoxynucleoside triphosphates (dNTPs) are the normal substrates for DNA synthesis catalyzed by polymerases such as HIV-1 reverse transcriptase (RT). However, substantial amounts of deoxynucleoside diphosphates (dNDPs) are also present in the cell. Use of dNDPs in HIV-1 DNA synthe

pmc-10741162.title: Fish Skin Grafts Affect Adenosine and Methionine Metabolism during Burn Wound Healing
pmc-10741162.creator: Aristotelis Kotronoulas, Adrián López García de Lomana, Helga Kristín Einarsdóttir, Hilmar Kjartansson, Randolph Stone, Óttar Rolfsson, Filippo Renò
pmc-10741162.description: Burn wound healing is a complex process orchestrated through successive biochemical events that span from weeks to months depending on the depth of the wound. Here, we report an untargeted metabolomics discovery approach to capture metabolic changes during the healing of deep partial-thickness (DPT) and full-thickness (FT) burn wounds in a porcine burn wound model.

pmc-11477637.title: A Multi-Feature Fusion Method for Life Prediction of Automotive Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell Based on TCN-GRU
pmc-11477637.creator: Jiaming Zhang, Fuwu Yan, Changqing Du, Yiming Zhang, Chao Zheng, Jinhai Wang, Ben Chen
pmc-11477637.description: The Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell (PEMFC) is a fast-developing battery technology, and the key to its reliability and lifespan improvement lies in the accurate assessment of durability. However, the degradation mechanism of the PEMFC is hard to determine and its internal parameters are highly coupled.

pmc-11532761.title: Analysis of Baseline Molecular Factors Associated With the Risk of Central Nervous System Progression Among Alectinib-Treated Patients With ALK–Positive NSCLC

pmc-11532761.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Typically self-limiting, it often responds to antiviral and neurotropic therapies. However, in patients with comorbidities that confer susceptibility to peripheral neuropathy (e.g.

pmc-13179205.title: Physicochemical and Biological Characterization of the TLR7 Agonist SZU-106
pmc-13179205.creator: Martin Herbst, Johannes Kipp, Sonja M. Kessler, Christian Wischke
pmc-13179205.description: ObjectiveToll-like receptor 7 (TLR7) recognizes single-stranded RNA and plays a crucial role in initiating immune responses against viral pathogens. This study characterizes SZU-106, a recently developed Toll-like receptor 7 (TLR7) agonist, focusing on its physicochemical and biological properties as key determinants for assessing its suitability for drug product development.

pmc-13383527.title: Associations between physical activity and sedentary time with sleep duration and sleep quality in adolescents
pmc-13383527.creator: Gunchmaa Nyam, Natalie Lander, Ana Maria Contardo Ayala, Claudia Strugnell, Jo Salmon
pmc-13383527.description: BackgroundTo examine the cross-sectional associations between objectively assessed physical activity and sedentary time, and both objectively and subjectively assessed sleep parameters (e.g., duration and quality) among Australian adolescents, including weekdays and weekends.MethodsBaseline data from the TransformUs Secondary effectiveness trial involved 193 adolescents (mean age 14.8 years) from Victoria, Australia.

pmc-13451899.title: Spatiotemporally synchronized dual-wavelength measurement of aerosol optical properties using a dual-differential sphere–tube coupled photoacoustic–scattering system
pmc-13451899.creator: Zhengang Li, Hepeng Zhang, Daming Dong, Yonghua Fang

pmc-13509794.title: Biomimetic Wearable Device for Dysphagia: Digital Conceptual Design via KANO-EWM-TOPSIS and Extended FCBS Mapping
pmc-13509794.creator: Ke Yin, Zilin Mao, Yiting Cui, Aimin Zhou
pmc-13509794.description: Biomimetic wearable devices provide non-invasive physical support for elderly patients with dysphagia. However, most existing assistive products adopt fixed layouts designed through empirical methods and cannot meet differentiated needs in household, social, and medical scenarios. To fill this gap, this study constructed an integrated design framework combining the KANO-EWM-TOPSIS hybrid model and extended FCBS mapping.

pmc-13624578.title: Quantitative liver ultrasound: current status and challenges
pmc-13624578.creator: Yunlin Huang, Yi Yu, Ying Wang, Yijie Qiu, Rui Cheng, Li Wei, Yi Dong
pmc-13624578.description: Ultrasound is the most widely used imaging modality for liver evaluation because it is accessible, portable, affordable, and repeatable. Quantitative liver ultrasound should therefore be understood not as a single technology, but as a set of biomarker strategies at different stages of development.
